List Widgets

List widgets

curl "https://api.paystack.co/widget?x=1" -H "Authorization: Bearer SECRET" -X GET

Query Parameters

perPage
Integer

How many. If not specified, we use a default value of 50.

color
String
optional

Colour

size
String

Size

Fetch Widget 

curl "https://api.paystack.co/widget/:widget_id" -H "Authorization: Bearer SECRET" -X GET

Path Parameters

id
Integer

Id
